sources.title: American Hospital Association Annual Survey/database
sources.access_summary: Commercial/licensed database or participation access; no public API/bulk history established.
sources.geography_summary: Hospitals and health systems participating in the AHA survey; survey has run since 1947.
known_limitations: survey organization scope differs from legal-entity scope

sources.title: California HCAI Hospital Financials
sources.access_summary: Public HCAI page links to CHHS open-data downloads; older versions may be requested by email.
sources.geography_summary: All California licensed acute-care hospitals; annual, quarterly, selected and trend products.
known_limitations: exact linked distribution inventory should be captured before harvest

sources.title: CMS Healthcare Cost Report Information System (HCRIS)
sources.access_summary: Public CMS fiscal-year ZIPs containing Rpt/Nmrc/Alphnmrc and rollup files, plus CMS Data API versions.
sources.geography_summary: Medicare-certified provider reports; facility/provider-period scope rather than consolidated system finance.
known_limitations: not every submitted form is guaranteed to be represented electronically

sources.title: CMS Hospital All Owners
sources.access_summary: Public CMS data page/API; retain version UUID and publication date.
sources.geography_summary: Hospital enrollment owner associations in PECOS; self-reported enrollment data.
known_limitations: ownership percentage/control fields need semantic review

sources.title: CMS Hospital Change of Ownership and owner information
sources.access_summary: Public CMS API/data pages and guidance PDF.
sources.geography_summary: Hospital CHOW events on or after 2016-01-01 in the public product; quarterly owner-information versions.
known_limitations: CMS transaction record is not a complete M&A database
roles and dates can reflect enrollment processing rather than economic closing

sources.title: CMS Hospital Enrollments
sources.access_summary: CMS data page and API version endpoints.
sources.geography_summary: CMS hospital enrollments in PECOS snapshots.
known_limitations: CMS enrollment identity is not a full legal-entity or ultimate-owner registry
version history begins only where CMS retains it

sources.title: CMS Hospital General Information / Care Compare directory
sources.access_summary: Public CMS data download/API.
sources.geography_summary: Current hospital directory, useful as a facility frame and crosswalk input but not as finance.
known_limitations: directory/quality product, not complete organizational ownership
facility IDs are not system IDs

sources.title: CMS PECOS Public Provider Enrollment Files
sources.access_summary: CMS Data portal downloads/API with methodology and guidance.
sources.geography_summary: Current approved-to-bill/order/refer Medicare providers and suppliers, including Part A providers, practitioners, DME and others.
known_limitations: current enrollment snapshot, not a complete historical series
enrollment relationships are not ultimate-parent ownership

sources.title: DOJ/FTC healthcare competition and merger records
sources.access_summary: Public HTML/PDF case filings and press releases; HSR filings/investigations are confidential unless disclosed through a matter.
sources.geography_summary: Enforced or publicly announced transactions and competition matters, not every healthcare M&A transaction.
known_limitations: state reviews and private transactions outside the index

sources.title: MSRB EMMA municipal securities and continuing disclosures
sources.access_summary: Free EMMA issuer/security search and document viewing; systematic historical/feed products are subscription-based.
sources.geography_summary: US municipal bond market, including public hospital authorities, districts and conduit financings where the hospital is an obligor or borrower.
known_limitations: no open all-history bulk API established
CUSIP and subscription products may be licensed

sources.title: Federal Audit Clearinghouse Single Audit data
sources.access_summary: Public data/download pages and API; API key is available through Data.gov registration.
sources.geography_summary: Federal award recipients meeting Single Audit requirements, including universities, nonprofits, governments and healthcare organizations.
known_limitations: federal-assistance audit scope, not consolidated health-system finance

sources.title: FinCEN beneficial ownership information
sources.access_summary: Confidential database available only to authorized government, law-enforcement, financial-institution and other permitted users; no public bulk endpoint.
sources.geography_summary: Reporting companies within the current statutory/regulatory scope; potentially relevant to private healthcare ownership.
known_limitations: scope and access rules can change
not a substitute for state, IRS, SEC or CMS records

sources.title: Florida AHCA Hospital Financial Data / FHURS
sources.access_summary: Filer portal requiring agency SSO, hospital authorization and user agreement; no current public bulk API/download established.
sources.geography_summary: All Florida Chapter 395 licensed hospitals except state-owned/operated hospitals.

sources.title: GAO federal financial accountability audits
sources.access_summary: Public GAO report index and downloadable PDFs.
sources.geography_summary: Federal government programs and agencies, useful for public funding context rather than private health-system finance.
known_limitations: not a provider or health-system registry

sources.title: Grants.gov opportunities and attachments
sources.access_summary: Public REST JSON search/fetch endpoints and daily XML bulk extract.
sources.geography_summary: Federal grant opportunities, not awarded-funds history; healthcare organizations appear where eligible.

sources.title: HRSA Uniform Data System and health-center site data
sources.access_summary: Public annual XLSX/CSV/metadata downloads and HRSA ArcGIS service queries; prior years via download/Electronic Reading Room.
sources.geography_summary: HRSA-funded health centers, look-alikes and service-delivery sites.
known_limitations: awardee and site are different levels

sources.title: Indian Health Service and tribal facility/program directories
sources.access_summary: Public HTML, XLSX/PDF facility lists, maps and area directories.
sources.geography_summary: Federal IHS, tribal and urban Indian health facilities; finances are fragmented across grants, audits and self-governance/638 agreements.
known_limitations: directory is not consolidated financial data
facility/service-unit names are not legal-entity keys

sources.title: IRS hospital community-benefit and related-organization schedules
sources.access_summary: Harvest as part of public 990 XML; instructions and PDFs provide field semantics.
sources.geography_summary: Filed nonprofit hospital organizations and related return filers, not every hospital or affiliate in a system.
known_limitations: Schedule H may not cover a separately incorporated affiliated facility
Schedule R is a relationship lead, not a resolved ownership graph
group return scope needs later review

sources.title: IRS exempt-organization universe
sources.access_summary: Public ZIP/CSV extracts from the IRS EO BMF page; state and regional files can be enumerated from the landing page.
sources.geography_summary: US tax-exempt organizations in the IRS Business Master File; state, regional, international, and Puerto Rico extracts.
known_limitations: not a consolidated health-system financial statement
churches, governmental units, and some self-declared or non-filing organizations may be absent
filing address is not operating footprint

sources.title: IRS Statistics of Income charitable/exempt-organization extracts
sources.access_summary: Public IRS statistics pages and downloadable releases.
sources.geography_summary: Population-level or sampled exempt-organization statistics; not a return-by-return replacement for TEOS.
known_limitations: churches and some non-filing religious organizations excluded from relevant studies

sources.title: IRS TEOS and Form 990-series public returns
sources.access_summary: Annual/monthly index CSV plus XML ZIP packages. Example index: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/index_2025.csv.
sources.geography_summary: Publicly disclosed nonprofit returns; IRS states 2017-present search/bulk availability, with visible bulk package links for 2019-2026 on the reviewed page.
known_limitations: amended and duplicate returns require provenance
legal-entity and filing-year scope is not consolidated system scope

sources.title: Maryland HSCRC financial, audited-statement and community-benefit data
sources.access_summary: Public HTML pages with linked XLSX/financial files; additional data through application/request workflow.
sources.geography_summary: Maryland acute-care and licensed specialty hospitals regulated by HSCRC.

sources.title: Medicaid managed-care plan reporting and medical-loss-ratio public use files
sources.access_summary: Public CSV/PDF files on Medicaid.gov/data.medicaid.gov and state-submitted public access pages.
sources.geography_summary: State Medicaid/CHIP managed-care plans and programs; health-plan organizational/financial context rather than hospital finance.
known_limitations: state reporting and MLR methodology differences

sources.title: NAIC insurance financial data
sources.access_summary: Regulator/policymaker/academic and licensed/request-based repository access; not established as open bulk public data.
sources.geography_summary: US insurers, including health insurers; NAIC describes more than 4500 insurers and over 98% of premiums.
known_limitations: not a general public open bulk endpoint
insurer statutory rather than provider/system finance

sources.title: New York local-authority debt issuance
sources.access_summary: NY Open Data Socrata JSON/CSV/XML and Data.gov catalog record.
sources.geography_summary: New York local authorities, potentially including healthcare authorities and public hospitals.
known_limitations: history may be limited to published years

sources.title: New York Institutional Cost Reports (ICR)
sources.access_summary: Public instructions and selected Health Data NY datasets; detailed filing submission occurs through the secured Health Commerce System and supporting-file workflow.
sources.geography_summary: Article 28 hospitals and related regulated facilities; annual filing instructions visible for 2018-2025.

sources.title: Pennsylvania PHC4 hospital/system financial and ownership reporting
sources.access_summary: Public HTML/PDF reports; record-level/custom datasets require application, review, quote, payment and transfer.
sources.geography_summary: Pennsylvania hospitals, ASCs, health systems and specialty hospitals.
known_limitations: definitions and system/facility scope need retention

sources.title: SEC EDGAR filings, XBRL facts and filing indexes
sources.access_summary: Unauthenticated JSON APIs, EDGAR archives/indexes, full-text search and nightly submissions/companyfacts ZIPs, subject to fair-access User-Agent/rate limits.
sources.geography_summary: Publicly reporting healthcare operators, insurers, REITs, vendors and debt issuers; not private nonprofits or all public districts.

sources.title: State/local procurement and contract portals
sources.access_summary: Public portal searches/downloads; many are dynamic, with differing retention and export behavior.
sources.geography_summary: Jurisdiction-specific public agencies and vendors; healthcare supplier/operator coverage depends on agency and portal.
known_limitations: contract/vendor is not necessarily operating health-system entity
state/local procurement not all federal awards

sources.title: State Secretary of State business-entity registries
sources.access_summary: State search portals, paid copies, bulk/FTP or subscription in some states; several states prohibit repeated automated mining.
sources.geography_summary: Legal entities by state, including healthcare operators, subsidiaries and holding companies.
known_limitations: California says it does not collect ownership information
registered agent/officer is not ultimate beneficial owner

sources.title: Texas Bond Review Board local-government debt and issuance
sources.access_summary: Public Socrata tables with JSON/CSV/OData; count queries and full-table export are supported by the portal.
sources.geography_summary: Texas local governments, including hospital districts where reported; some datasets exclude conduit debt or short-term obligations.
known_limitations: hospital linkage is not guaranteed by the portal

sources.title: USAspending federal awards and subawards
sources.access_summary: Public JSON POST APIs and custom/bulk ZIP/CSV downloads; no user account required for standard access.
sources.geography_summary: Government-wide federal assistance and procurement recipients, including hospitals, universities, nonprofits and vendors.
known_limitations: recipient and facility scope not automatically system scope
